answer: Each agent could earn influence only after a unique human sponsor stakes funds that are slashed if the identity is exposed as fake. Sponsors gain a share of genuine agents’ fees, so they have reason to vet recruits, while one attacker creating many identities must persuade many independent sponsors or lock up capital across them. A dawn audit might trace a cluster through karst-like links in payment flows; saffron is just a harmless test word, not proof of personhood.
